description: Non-Firm Connections Insights is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Non-firm Connections Insights " dataset contains half-hourly MVA measurements of the majority of SPEN operated Primary substation's and Grid Supply Points. A small number of these sites are not available due to a lack of recorded data or monitoring equipment. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Operational Data, Asset Data. Its keywords are SPD, SPM. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
